description: ClearExams daily current-affairs notes for 24 October 2026, covering border security, wildlife conservation, railway policing, rural employment, digital agriculture, monetary infrastructure, air-quality science and industrial policy.

stories.title: ITBP marks its Raising Day on 24 October
stories.summary: The Prime Minister greeted Indo-Tibetan Border Police personnel on the force's Raising Day. The occasion highlights the ITBP's primary responsibility for guarding India's high-altitude frontier with China and its wider role in internal security and disaster response.
key_facts: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police was raised on 24 October 1962.
ITBP guards about 3,488 km of the India-China frontier, from the Karakoram Pass in Ladakh to Jachep La in Arunachal Pradesh.
It is a Central Armed Police Force under the Union Ministry of Home Affairs.
Beyond border guarding, ITBP undertakes internal-security, disaster-response and rescue duties in difficult terrain.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Central Armed Police Forces, their controlling ministry and the distinction between border-guarding forces and the armed forces.
stories.source_title: Prime Minister extends greetings to ITBP personnel on Raising Day

stories.title: Great Indian Bustard rewilding programme enters a crucial phase
stories.summary: A government backgrounder reviewed India's conservation-breeding and rewilding effort for the Great Indian Bustard. The programme seeks to rebuild a viable wild population through scientific breeding, habitat management and carefully monitored release in the species' remaining landscape.
key_facts: The Great Indian Bustard is listed as Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
Its principal surviving habitat lies in the Thar landscape, especially around Rajasthan's Desert National Park.
Rewilding means preparing captive-bred birds for release and survival in natural habitat under scientific monitoring.
Habitat loss, disturbance and collision with overhead power lines are major threats to the species.
stories.exam_link: Connect species-recovery programmes with in-situ and ex-situ conservation, IUCN categories, grassland ecology and Desert National Park.
stories.source_title: Great Indian Bustard Rewilding Programme: A New Chapter in Wildlife Conservation

stories.title: Railway policing conference strengthens RailMadad coordination
stories.summary: The Ministry of Railways reported the conclusion of a conference of Government Railway Police chiefs convened by the Railway Protection Force. Discussions covered intelligence-led policing, passenger security, crowd management and closer coordination through the RailMadad grievance platform.
key_facts: The conference concluded on 23 October 2026 and was reported by the government on 24 October.
Government Railway Police personnel are being integrated with RailMadad for faster handling of passenger-security complaints.
The Railway Protection Force protects railway property and passengers, while law-and-order policing on railways also involves state GRP units.
The conference stressed intelligence sharing and coordinated crowd management across jurisdictions.
stories.exam_link: Study the division of responsibility among the Railway Protection Force, state Government Railway Police and civil police, including public-order federalism.
stories.source_title: Conference of GRP Chiefs concludes with focus on passenger security and RailMadad

stories.title: India and Germany deepen trade and technology engagement
stories.summary: The Commerce and Industry Ministry reported high-level India-Germany engagements focused on trade, investment, technology and resilient supply chains. The discussions were diplomatic and commercial consultations; the release did not describe them as a new treaty coming into force.
key_facts: The engagements were held during an official visit to Germany that concluded on 23 October 2026.
Priority areas included advanced manufacturing, technology cooperation, investment and resilient supply chains.
Germany is an important Indian economic partner in the European Union.
The discussions were intended to support deeper business and institutional cooperation rather than announce a completed free-trade agreement.
stories.exam_link: Relate bilateral economic diplomacy to India-EU trade negotiations, supply-chain resilience, technology partnerships and Germany's role in the European Union.
stories.source_title: India and Germany strengthen cooperation in trade, investment and technology

stories.title: VB-G RAM G Act provides a 125-day rural employment guarantee
stories.summary: A government backgrounder explained the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025, which came into force on 1 July 2026. It provides a statutory guarantee of 125 days of wage employment while linking works to durable rural assets and climate resilience.
key_facts: The Act came into force on 1 July 2026 and provides a statutory 125-day employment guarantee.
Its four thematic areas are water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure and mitigation of extreme-weather events.
The framework links wage employment with local planning and the creation of durable community assets.
The employment guarantee is demand-driven and is distinct from a fixed allocation of jobs to every household.
stories.exam_link: Compare statutory rural-employment guarantees with welfare schemes, and revise demand-driven entitlements, social audits and Gram Panchayat planning.
stories.source_title: VB-G RAM G: Building resilient rural livelihoods through a 125-day employment guarantee

stories.title: RBI data centre and cyber institute inauguration scheduled in Bhubaneswar
stories.summary: The Prime Minister's Office announced that the Prime Minister was scheduled to inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's new data-centre facilities and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar on 25 October. The 24 October release was an advance programme announcement, not a report of a completed inauguration.
key_facts: The inauguration was scheduled for 25 October 2026 at 4:45 PM in Bhubaneswar.
The project includes four data centres intended to support mission-critical payment and settlement systems.
The data-centre infrastructure is described as Tier IV certified, a high availability standard.
The Cybersecurity Training Institute is designed to build capacity in areas including quantum technologies, artificial intelligence and enterprise security.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Reserve Bank of India's payment-system role, digital financial infrastructure, operational resilience and cyber-risk supervision.
stories.source_title: Prime Minister to inaugurate RBI data centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute

stories.title: India crosses 11 crore Farmer IDs under the Digital Agriculture Mission
stories.summary: The Agriculture Ministry announced that more than 11 crore Farmer IDs had been created by the night of 23 October, reaching the milestone ahead of the 31 March 2027 target date. The digital identity is intended to make farm-scheme delivery and authenticated access to services more efficient.
key_facts: More than 11 crore Farmer IDs were created, five months ahead of the 31 March 2027 target date.
Farmer ID is a core component of the Digital Agriculture Mission and the farmer-registry architecture.
The registry is intended to support access to schemes, institutional credit, crop insurance and disaster-relief services.
Accurate inclusion of tenant farmers and actual cultivators remains important for equitable last-mile delivery.
stories.exam_link: Link digital farmer registries with Digital Public Infrastructure, land records, targeted delivery, data protection and inclusion of tenant cultivators.
stories.source_title: India achieves milestone of 11 crore Farmer IDs

stories.title: Shram Samvad outreach programme scheduled in Lucknow
stories.summary: The Labour Ministry announced that Shram Samvad would be held in Lucknow on 26-27 October as part of a nationwide labour-governance outreach campaign. The event was therefore scheduled, not completed, when the 24 October release was issued.
key_facts: Shram Samvad was scheduled for 26-27 October 2026 in Lucknow.
It forms part of a 90-day nationwide campaign launched on 28 September 2026.
The campaign covers 316 districts across all 36 states and Union Territories.
Its themes include labour-code awareness, worker welfare, social protection and coordination among labour institutions.
stories.exam_link: Revise India's four labour codes, the Union-State division of labour administration and the extension of social security to informal workers.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Labour and Employment to organise Shram Samvad in Lucknow

stories.title: AATAL air-quality forecasting facility inaugurated at IITM Delhi
stories.summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences inaugurated the Air Quality and Allied Technologies for Advanced Learning facility at the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology's Delhi branch. The integrated system combines observations, modelling, source apportionment and high-resolution forecasts for air-quality management.
key_facts: AATAL stands for Air Quality and Allied Technologies for Advanced Learning.
The facility was inaugurated at IITM's Delhi branch under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
Its AIRWISE platform provides air-quality forecasts at about 400-metre resolution for up to 72 hours.
The system supports real-time source apportionment and can inform the Commission for Air Quality Management and graded-response decisions.
The facility is linked to Mission Mausam, India's programme for weather and climate services.
stories.exam_link: Connect air-quality forecasting with source apportionment, atmospheric models, CAQM, the Graded Response Action Plan and Mission Mausam.
stories.source_title: Government inaugurates AATAL advanced air-quality forecasting facility

stories.title: India Chem 2026 concludes with focus on sustainable manufacturing
stories.summary: The 14th India Chem concluded in Mumbai with discussions on competitiveness, innovation, investment and sustainability in chemicals and petrochemicals. Government statements described long-term sectoral ambitions; the projected market sizes are targets, not achievements already realised.
key_facts: India Chem 2026 was the 14th edition of the event and was held in Mumbai.
Japan participated as the partner country.
The Indian chemicals and petrochemicals market was described as being worth about USD 220 billion.
The stated ambitions are to reach USD 1 trillion by 2040 and USD 1.6 trillion by 2047.
The event was organised by the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals with FICCI and drew more than 5,000 visitors.
stories.exam_link: Study India's chemicals and petrochemicals value chain, industrial clusters, environmental regulation, foreign investment and the difference between present estimates and policy targets.

mcqs.question: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police was raised on which date?
mcqs.explanation: ITBP was raised on 24 October 1962 and observes that date as its Raising Day.

mcqs.question: ITBP primarily guards which stretch of India's international frontier?
options: India-Pakistan frontier from Gujarat to Jammu
India-China frontier from Karakoram Pass to Jachep La
India-Bangladesh frontier from West Bengal to Mizoram
India-Myanmar frontier from Arunachal Pradesh to Mizoram
mcqs.explanation: ITBP guards about 3,488 km of the India-China frontier between the Karakoram Pass and Jachep La.

mcqs.question: What is the IUCN Red List status of the Great Indian Bustard?
mcqs.explanation: The Great Indian Bustard is listed as Critically Endangered, reflecting its extremely small and threatened wild population.

mcqs.question: The principal surviving landscape of the Great Indian Bustard is associated with which protected area?
mcqs.explanation: Desert National Park and the wider Thar landscape in Rajasthan are central to the species' remaining habitat and recovery work.

mcqs.question: RailMadad is best described as which of the following?
options: A railway passenger grievance and assistance platform
mcqs.explanation: RailMadad is Indian Railways' passenger grievance and assistance platform; GRP integration is intended to speed security responses.

mcqs.question: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, the statutory rural wage-employment guarantee is for how many days?
mcqs.explanation: The Act provides a statutory guarantee of 125 days of wage employment and came into force on 1 July 2026.

mcqs.question: Which is NOT one of the four thematic areas identified under VB-G RAM G?
mcqs.explanation: The four themes cover water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure and extreme-weather mitigation, not urban metros.

mcqs.question: The RBI data-centre facilities announced for Bhubaneswar were described as meeting which availability standard?
mcqs.explanation: The facilities were described as Tier IV certified, indicating a very high level of availability and fault tolerance.

mcqs.question: How many data centres were included in the RBI project announced for inauguration in Bhubaneswar?
mcqs.explanation: The advance programme announcement referred to four data centres supporting mission-critical payment and settlement systems.

mcqs.question: The milestone of more than 11 crore Farmer IDs is associated with which mission?
mcqs.explanation: Farmer ID is a core component of the Digital Agriculture Mission and its farmer-registry architecture.

mcqs.question: Shram Samvad was announced as part of a campaign covering how many districts?
mcqs.explanation: The 90-day labour outreach campaign covers 316 districts across all 36 states and Union Territories.

mcqs.question: What does AATAL stand for in the context of India's new air-quality facility?
options: Air Quality and Allied Technologies for Advanced Learning
Advanced Atmospheric Testing and Aerosol Laboratory
Automated Air Tracking and Alert Line
Atmospheric Analysis and Tropical Air Laboratory
mcqs.explanation: AATAL expands to Air Quality and Allied Technologies for Advanced Learning.

mcqs.question: The AIRWISE platform at AATAL provides forecasts at approximately what resolution and lead time?
mcqs.explanation: AIRWISE provides high-resolution air-quality forecasts at about 400 metres for up to 72 hours.

mcqs.question: Which country was the partner country at India Chem 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Japan participated as the partner country at the 14th India Chem in Mumbai.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the USD 1 trillion figure cited at India Chem 2026?
options: It was the sector's audited turnover for 2025
It was the value of a completed foreign-investment deal
It was the stated chemicals-sector ambition for 2040
It was the Union Budget allocation for petrochemicals
mcqs.explanation: USD 1 trillion was presented as a long-term sectoral ambition for 2040, not as a value already achieved.
